h011: From raw-material provenance to component manufacturing, repair services and research commercialization, ACP connects industrial processes through a verifiable, collaborative on-chain protocol network.
h033: Advanced composites span research, production, use and repair. Starting with real operations, ACP designs traceable, rights-verifiable and collaborative processes to address fragmented lifecycle information, asset liquidity and cross-institutional coordination.

h165: ACP is a governance and utility token, not equity in a physical company or a promise of fixed returns. RWA credentials are distinct from physical assets; transactions, delivery, logistics and acceptance follow applicable offline contracts and procedures. This website is based on whitepaper V1.1; formal agreements, contracts and subsequent announcements govern specific business and governance mechanisms.
